_comment: pc/boat-slots: the boat library's slots folded into packs of up to 8 entries, one material slot each. A packed face keeps its library slot as its entry (UV1.x); MI_Boat_<Pack> (make_materials.py) holds the entries' values. The C++ mirror is BoatPacks.h (SailingSim.Visual.BoatPacks). Append entries, never reorder: imported meshes carry the indices. PackCanoe is exactly the canoe slots J22Mesh and FleetMesh measure.
